001package org.clafer.compiler;
002
003import java.math.BigDecimal;
004import java.util.ArrayList;
005import java.util.HashMap;
006import java.util.List;
007import java.util.Map;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.Solution;
009import org.clafer.ast.AstAbstractClafer;
010import org.clafer.ast.AstClafer;
011import org.clafer.ast.AstConcreteClafer;
012import org.clafer.ast.AstDecimalClafer;
013import org.clafer.ast.AstStringClafer;
014import org.clafer.ast.compiler.AstSolutionMap;
015import org.clafer.collection.Pair;
016import org.clafer.common.Check;
017import org.clafer.instance.InstanceClafer;
018import org.clafer.instance.InstanceModel;
019import org.clafer.ir.IrIntVar;
020import org.clafer.ir.IrSetVar;
021import org.clafer.ir.IrStringVar;
022import org.clafer.ir.compiler.IrSolutionMap;
023
024/**
025 *
026 * @author jimmy
027 */
028public class ClaferSolutionMap {
029
030    private final AstSolutionMap astSolution;
031    private final IrSolutionMap irSolution;
032
033    ClaferSolutionMap(AstSolutionMap astSolution, IrSolutionMap irSolution) {
034        this.astSolution = Check.notNull(astSolution);
035        this.irSolution = Check.notNull(irSolution);
036    }
037
038    public InstanceModel getInstance() {
039        return getInstance(irSolution);
040    }
041
042    public InstanceModel getInstance(Solution solution) {
043        return getInstance(irSolution.fromSolution(solution));
044    }
045
046    private InstanceModel getInstance(IrSolutionMap irSolution) {
047        Map<Pair<AstClafer, Integer>, InstanceClafer> referenceMap = new HashMap<>();
048        List<InstanceClafer> topInstances = new ArrayList<>();
049        for (AstConcreteClafer child : astSolution.getModel().getChildren()) {
050            // [0] because top clafers only have exactly one children set
051            IrSetVar topSetIrVar = astSolution.getSiblingVars(child)[0];
052            int[] topIds = irSolution.getValue(topSetIrVar);
053            for (int topId : topIds) {
054                topInstances.add(getInstanceClafer(child, topId, referenceMap, irSolution));
055            }
056        }
057        return new InstanceModel(topInstances.toArray(new InstanceClafer[topInstances.size()]));
058    }
059
060    private InstanceClafer getInstanceClafer(AstConcreteClafer clafer, int id,
061            final Map<Pair<AstClafer, Integer>, InstanceClafer> referenceMap, IrSolutionMap irSolution) {
062        InstanceClafer instanceClafer = getInstanceClaferImpl(clafer, id, referenceMap, irSolution);
063        referenceMap.put(new Pair<>(clafer, id), instanceClafer);
064        return instanceClafer;
065    }
066
067    private InstanceClafer getInstanceClaferImpl(AstConcreteClafer clafer, int id,
068            final Map<Pair<AstClafer, Integer>, InstanceClafer> referenceMap, IrSolutionMap irSolution) {
069        List<InstanceClafer> children = new ArrayList<>();
070        Pair<AstClafer, Object> ref = getInstanceClaferImpl(clafer, id, true, children, referenceMap, irSolution);
071        InstanceClafer[] childrenArray = children.toArray(new InstanceClafer[children.size()]);
072        if (ref == null) {
073            return new InstanceClafer(clafer, id, null, childrenArray);
074        }
075        if (ref.getFst().isPrimitive()) {
076            return new InstanceClafer(clafer, id, ref.getSnd(), childrenArray);
077        }
078        final Pair<AstClafer, Integer> key = new Pair<>(ref.getFst(), (Integer) ref.getSnd());
079        if (referenceMap.containsKey(key)) {
080            return new InstanceClafer(clafer, id, referenceMap.get(key), childrenArray);
081        }
082        return new InstanceClafer(clafer, id, null, childrenArray) {
083
084            @Override
085            public boolean hasRef() {
086                return true;
087            }
088
089            @Override
090            public Object getRef() {
091                return referenceMap.get(key);
092            }
093        };
094    }
095
096    /**
097     * Adds the children of the clafer and of its super clafers to the list.
098     * Returns the reference of the clafer, or the reference it inherits, if
099     * withRef holds; a reference redefined by a sub clafer overrides the
100     * inherited one, but the inherited children are still added.
101     */
102    private Pair<AstClafer, Object> getInstanceClaferImpl(AstClafer clafer, int id, boolean withRef,
103            List<InstanceClafer> children, final Map<Pair<AstClafer, Integer>, InstanceClafer> referenceMap, IrSolutionMap irSolution) {
104        for (AstConcreteClafer child : clafer.getChildren()) {
105            IrSetVar childSetIrVar = astSolution.getSiblingVars(child)[id];
106            int[] childIds = irSolution.getValue(childSetIrVar);
107            for (int childId : childIds) {
108                children.add(getInstanceClafer(child, childId, referenceMap, irSolution));
109            }
110        }
111        Pair<AstClafer, Object> ref = null;
112        if (withRef && clafer.hasRef()) {
113            AstClafer targetType = clafer.getRef().getTargetType();
114            if (targetType instanceof AstStringClafer) {
115                IrStringVar refIrVar = astSolution.getRefStrings(clafer)[id];
116                String value = irSolution.getValue(refIrVar);
117                ref = new Pair<>(targetType, value);
118            } else if (targetType instanceof AstDecimalClafer) {
119                IrIntVar refIrVar = astSolution.getRefVars(clafer)[id];
120                int value = irSolution.getValue(refIrVar);
121                ref = new Pair<>(targetType, toDecimal(astSolution.getAnalysis().getScope().unscaleDecimal(value)));
122            } else {
123                IrIntVar refIrVar = astSolution.getRefVars(clafer)[id];
124                Integer value = irSolution.getValue(refIrVar);
125                if (targetType instanceof AstAbstractClafer) {
126                    Pair<AstConcreteClafer, Integer> concreteRef = astSolution.getAnalysis().getConcreteId(
127                            targetType, value);
128                    targetType = concreteRef.getFst();
129                    value = concreteRef.getSnd();
130                }
131                ref = new Pair<>(targetType, value);
132            }
133        }
134        if (clafer.hasSuperClafer()) {
135            Pair<AstClafer, Object> superRef = getInstanceClaferImpl(clafer.getSuperClafer(),
136                    id + astSolution.getAnalysis().getOffsets(clafer.getSuperClafer()).getOffset(clafer),
137                    withRef && ref == null, children, referenceMap, irSolution);
138            if (ref == null) {
139                ref = superRef;
140            }
141        }
142        return ref;
143    }
144
145    /**
146     * The decimal in its shortest form with at least one fractional digit,
147     * e.g. 199.0 and 12.5.
148     */
149    private static BigDecimal toDecimal(BigDecimal value) {
150        BigDecimal shortest = value.stripTrailingZeros();
151        return shortest.scale() < 1 ? shortest.setScale(1) : shortest;
152    }
153
154    public AstSolutionMap getAstSolution() {
155        return astSolution;
156    }
157
158    public IrSolutionMap getIrSolution() {
159        return irSolution;
160    }
161}
